title: Oman - Official Holidays (Multilingual: ar+en_US)
description: Comprehensive Oman (عُمان / Uman) official holidays from 1970 through 2030. All vacanza supported_languages: ar, en_US; all supported_categories: public (public:807). Country code OM. No subdivisions in vacanza (single national list). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) via holidays.OM(years=range(1970, 2031), language=L, categories=(C,), islamic_show_estimated=True) iteration over L in ('ar', 'en_US') and C in ('public',). Suffixes for estimated/observed dates lifted into separate boolean flags (is_estimated=652, is_observed=0). Name collisions on the same date concatenated with '; ' (vacanza native behavior). Native Arabic preserved via ensure_ascii=False.
